name: hyperframes
description: HyperFrames — write videos as HTML and render them to MP4: scaffold, lint/check, snapshot frames, edit the timeline, add catalog blocks, make media, and render locally or on HeyGen's cloud through the hyperframes CLI.

settings.label: CLI version
settings.description: The npm version of the hyperframes CLI that Install puts in place, e.g. `latest` or `0.8.226`. Pin it when renders have to stay reproducible across reinstalls; press Reinstall after changing it.

settings.label: HeyGen sign-in mode
settings.description: Signing in is OPTIONAL. Local authoring and rendering need no account; HeyGen sign-in only unlocks cloud rendering, the music catalog, asset search, HeyGen voices, avatars and generated media. Exactly one mode is in force: Authenticate signs out first and then uses this one, and the plugin counts as signed in only for the mode set here (always, in local mode).

options.label: Local only (no HeyGen account)
options.description: Author and render on this server only. Nothing to sign in to, so the plugin always reads as authenticated; Authenticate just drops any stored HeyGen session. Cloud rendering and HeyGen media are unavailable.

options.label: Device code (sign in as a person)
options.description: Authenticate prints a HeyGen URL and code; a person approves it in a browser and the server acts as that HeyGen account, on its plan and credits. The session refreshes itself until it is revoked.

options.label: API key
options.description: Uses the HeyGen API key below. Nobody has to be present, and usage is billed to that key's API credits rather than a HyperFrames plan.

settings.label: Usage telemetry
settings.description: Whether the CLI sends its anonymous usage counters to HyperFrames (linked to the HeyGen account once signed in).

secrets.label: HeyGen API key
secrets.description: From HeyGen → Settings → API. Read by the CLI from the environment, so it never appears on a command line. Ignored in device-code mode.
